kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نرتعف (form VIII)
# نَرْتَعِفُ (nartaʕifu) /nar.ta.ʕi.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# نُرْتَعَفُ (nurtaʕafu) /nur.ta.ʕa.fu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# نَرْتَعِفَ (nartaʕifa) /nar.ta.ʕi.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# نُرْتَعَفَ (nurtaʕafa) /nur.ta.ʕa.fa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
